note: T1, fixed in TB1: a padded cell over a share column sat off its column (centred cell 2.5 pt right here). Cause: the share cell was {flexGrow, flexBasis: 0} with the author's padding on the same box, and the engine keeps the padding as the smallest basis (src/runtime/components/table.ts, columnStyles). A share-only cell now sits in an unpadded wrapper that takes the share; the visible cell grows inside it.
